+export async function getRate(code: string): Promise<number | null> {
+  try {
+    const res = await fetch(`https://rates.example.com/v1/${code}`, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(3000) })
+    if (!res.ok) return null
+    return (await res.json()).rate
+  } catch (err) {
+    logger.warn({ err, code }, 'rate lookup failed')
+    return null
+  }
+}
